data.name: Tenaya Lake: Family Swimming & Beach Day
data.description: Bring your family, kids, and even grandparents to a sandy beach at Tenaya Lake in Yosemite. Your guide has everything ready, like chairs, towels, beach blankets, games, drinks, and lunch. You can just show up and have fun!

meeting_point.address: Tenaya Lake Picnic Area, Yosemite, CA US

data.cancellation_notes:
Policy: Full payment due at booking

Cancel 30+ days → full refund minus platform & CC fees

Cancel 7–29 days → 50% refund minus fees

Cancel 0–6 days → no refund

Trips are never canceled due to weather
data.booking_notes:
**Client Packing List:**
•  Sun Hat
•  Sunglasses
•  Sunscreen
•  Bug Spray
•  Swimsuit
•  Sandals
•  Raincoat
•  Warm Layer
*We will provide towels and everything else you may need!*

**Optional:**
•  We provide water and soda, you can bring anything else you'd like to add to the cooler
•  Child Life Jacket
•  Cash, to tip your guide!
